Card Q&A.q: A Tamer card is in a Digimon’s digivolution cards. If that Digimon is deleted, can this card's [All Turns] effect play the Tamer card that used to be in that Digimon’s digivolution cards from my trash without paying its memory cost?

Effect: [On Play] You may play 1 Tamer card with an inherited effect from your hand without paying its memory cost.
[All Turns][Once Per Turn] When one of your Digimon with a Tamer card in its digivolution cards is deleted, you may play 1 Tamer card from your trash without paying its memory cost.
